summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-listed universe around regulated niche API suppliers. The strongest direct underfollowed US-listed match found is Amphastar, which discloses API manufacturing and insulin API sales, including a named MannKind dependency. Dr. Reddy's provides a cleaner India/China-plus-one API reference asset via its US-listed ADR, though it is broader and more visible than the ideal obscure niche target. Hawkins is a speculative second-order distributor/materials-gate candidate, not yet proven as a regulated API bottleneck. MannKind is included as a hidden customer-dependency case because Afrezza's insulin API supply appears tied to Amphastar, illustrating the re-validation/single-source lock-in mechanism from the customer side.
